stem: What does the interaction between Mom and the boys show about her?

options.label: A
options.text: Mom is eager to help the narrator with his request.

options.label: B
options.text: Mom tries to consider everyone’s feelings when making decisions.

options.label: C
options.text: Mom is angry that she has to give up her office for the narrator.

options.label: D
options.text: Mom expects her children to act perfectly at all times.
